-- =============================================================================
-- TOPSIDE CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL
-- Final Consumers: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (FS variant) and
--                  CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (RX variant)
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_week_ending_from  STRING  -- Low bound filter on week_year (from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK, unresolved)
--   @ip_week_ending_to    STRING  -- High bound filter on week_year (from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK, unresolved)
--   @ip_version_comp_flag STRING  -- Filter on comp_ver in ZTSRP_COMPFL (from SFN_ACTUALS_COMP_FLAG, unresolved)
-- =============================================================================
-- NOTE: TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR is NOT present in Columns_Mapping_v3.
--       Its BQ_FULL_TABLE cannot be resolved from the supplied mapping.
--       See ISSUES TO FIX in the description file.
--       The placeholder `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR` is used
--       to mark this unresolved source; replace with the correct BQ_FULL_TABLE
--       before execution.
-- =============================================================================

-- ============================================================
-- QUERY 1: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS -- FS (Full Store) Variant
-- ============================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS
-- Logic: Reads topside adjustment facts from the physical source table
--        TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR, filters to client '110' or '200',
--        and applies the week_year range filter from runtime parameters.
--        All 25 columns (9 attributes + 16 measures) are projected.
-- Source: REQUIRES_VALIDATION.TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR
--         (BQ_FULL_TABLE not found in Columns_Mapping_v3 -- see ISSUES TO FIX)
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200')
--          week_year BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS AS (
  SELECT
    application,
    description,
    mandt,
    prctr,
    s4_account,
    segment,
    type,
    week_year,
    zyear,
    fs_bud,
    fs_fct,
    fs_flash,
    fs_ly,
    rx_bud,
    rx_fct,
    rx_flash,
    rx_ly,
    sc_90as1_bud,
    sc_90as1_fct,
    sc_90as1_flash,
    sc_90as1_ly,
    sc_90as3_bud,
    sc_90as3_fct,
    sc_90as3_flash,
    sc_90as3_ly
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: BQ_FULL_TABLE for TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR not in Columns_Mapping_v3
  FROM `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR`
  WHERE mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND week_year BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: STORE_ATTRIBUTES
-- Logic: Reads store master attributes from v_ztsrp_attr_act, filtered
--        to client '120' or '200'. Projects only the subset of columns
--        consumed by the composite view join.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTRIBUTES AS (
  SELECT
    strnum,
    prctr,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Topside_With_Store_Attributes
-- Logic: Left outer joins TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS to STORE_ATTRIBUTES on
--        prctr, adding store hierarchy and geographic attributes to
--        each topside adjustment row.
-- Source: TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (left), STORE_ATTRIBUTES (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on t.prctr = s.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Store_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    t.application,
    t.description,
    t.mandt,
    t.prctr,
    t.s4_account,
    t.segment,
    t.type,
    t.week_year,
    t.zyear,
    t.fs_bud,
    t.fs_fct,
    t.fs_flash,
    t.fs_ly,
    t.rx_bud,
    t.rx_fct,
    t.rx_flash,
    t.rx_ly,
    t.sc_90as1_bud,
    t.sc_90as1_fct,
    t.sc_90as1_flash,
    t.sc_90as1_ly,
    t.sc_90as3_bud,
    t.sc_90as3_fct,
    t.sc_90as3_flash,
    t.sc_90as3_ly,
    s.strnum,
    s.division_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.district_desc,
    s.region_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.area_code,
    s.area_desc,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code
  FROM TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS t
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTRIBUTES s
    ON t.prctr = s.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: COMP_FLAG
-- Logic: Reads comp flag data from v_ztsrp_compfl, filtered to the
--        runtime comp version parameter. Projects prctr, zweek,
--        fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk, and comp_ver for the downstream join.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    zweek,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    comp_ver
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Topside_With_Comp_Flag
-- Logic: Left outer joins Topside_With_Store_Attributes to COMP_FLAG
--        on prctr and week_year = zweek (both STRING per Columns_Mapping_v3),
--        adding fs_comp_wk and rx_comp_wk for the comp flag calculation.
-- Source: Topside_With_Store_Attributes (left), COMP_FLAG (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j1.prctr = c.prctr AND j1.week_year = c.zweek
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Comp_Flag AS (
  SELECT
    j1.mandt,
    j1.application,
    j1.description,
    j1.prctr,
    j1.s4_account,
    j1.segment,
    j1.type,
    j1.week_year,
    j1.zyear,
    j1.strnum,
    j1.division_code,
    j1.division_desc,
    j1.district_code,
    j1.district_desc,
    j1.region_desc,
    j1.region_code,
    j1.rep_mkt_code,
    j1.rep_mkt_desc,
    j1.city,
    j1.state,
    j1.fs_open_dat,
    j1.rx_open_dat,
    j1.area_code,
    j1.area_desc,
    j1.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j1.fs_bud,
    j1.fs_fct,
    j1.fs_flash,
    j1.fs_ly,
    j1.rx_bud,
    j1.rx_fct,
    j1.rx_flash,
    j1.rx_ly,
    j1.sc_90as1_bud,
    j1.sc_90as1_fct,
    j1.sc_90as1_flash,
    j1.sc_90as1_ly,
    j1.sc_90as3_bud,
    j1.sc_90as3_fct,
    j1.sc_90as3_flash,
    j1.sc_90as3_ly,
    c.fs_comp_wk,
    c.rx_comp_wk,
    j1.rx_division_code,
    j1.rx_area_code,
    j1.rx_region_code,
    j1.rx_district_code
  FROM Topside_With_Store_Attributes j1
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG c
    ON j1.prctr = c.prctr
   AND j1.week_year = c.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: RETAIL_CALENDAR
-- Logic: Reads retail calendar week data from v_ztfigl_rcalweek,
--        projecting only the three columns needed for the downstream
--        join: zrwstrtdate, zrwenddate, and zzweek.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- =====================================================================
RETAIL_CALENDAR AS (
  SELECT
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    zzweek
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Topside_With_Retail_Calendar
-- Logic: Left outer joins Topside_With_Comp_Flag to RETAIL_CALENDAR
--        on week_year = zzweek (both STRING per Columns_Mapping_v3),
--        adding zrwstrtdate (DATE) and zrwenddate (DATE) for the output.
-- Source: Topside_With_Comp_Flag (left), RETAIL_CALENDAR (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j2.week_year = r.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Retail_Calendar AS (
  SELECT
    j2.sc_90as3_ly,
    j2.sc_90as3_flash,
    j2.sc_90as3_fct,
    j2.sc_90as3_bud,
    j2.sc_90as1_ly,
    j2.sc_90as1_flash,
    j2.sc_90as1_fct,
    j2.sc_90as1_bud,
    j2.rx_ly,
    j2.rx_flash,
    j2.rx_fct,
    j2.rx_bud,
    j2.fs_ly,
    j2.fs_flash,
    j2.fs_fct,
    j2.fs_bud,
    j2.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j2.area_desc,
    j2.area_code,
    j2.rx_open_dat,
    j2.fs_open_dat,
    j2.state,
    j2.city,
    j2.rep_mkt_desc,
    j2.rep_mkt_code,
    j2.region_code,
    j2.region_desc,
    j2.district_desc,
    j2.district_code,
    j2.division_desc,
    j2.division_code,
    j2.strnum,
    j2.zyear,
    j2.week_year,
    j2.type,
    j2.segment,
    j2.s4_account,
    j2.prctr,
    j2.description,
    j2.application,
    j2.mandt,
    r.zrwstrtdate,
    r.zrwenddate,
    j2.fs_comp_wk,
    j2.rx_comp_wk,
    j2.rx_division_code,
    j2.rx_area_code,
    j2.rx_region_code,
    j2.rx_district_code
  FROM Topside_With_Comp_Flag j2
  LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CALENDAR r
    ON j2.week_year = r.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Reads profit center text from v_cepct, projecting prctr and
--        ltext (the long text) for the downstream join.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    ltext
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text
-- Logic: Left outer joins Topside_With_Retail_Calendar to
--        PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on prctr, adding ltext aliased as
--        profit_center_descr per the logical model rename.
-- Source: Topside_With_Retail_Calendar (left), PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j3.prctr = p.prctr
-- Calculation: ltext renamed to profit_center_descr (meaningful rename per source)
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text AS (
  SELECT
    j3.mandt,
    j3.application,
    j3.description,
    j3.prctr,
    j3.s4_account,
    j3.segment,
    j3.type,
    j3.week_year,
    j3.zyear,
    j3.strnum,
    j3.division_code,
    j3.division_desc,
    j3.district_code,
    j3.district_desc,
    j3.region_desc,
    j3.region_code,
    j3.rep_mkt_code,
    j3.rep_mkt_desc,
    j3.city,
    j3.state,
    j3.fs_open_dat,
    j3.rx_open_dat,
    j3.area_code,
    j3.area_desc,
    j3.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j3.fs_bud,
    j3.fs_fct,
    j3.fs_flash,
    j3.fs_ly,
    j3.rx_bud,
    j3.rx_fct,
    j3.rx_flash,
    j3.rx_ly,
    j3.sc_90as1_bud,
    j3.sc_90as1_fct,
    j3.sc_90as1_flash,
    j3.sc_90as1_ly,
    j3.sc_90as3_bud,
    j3.sc_90as3_fct,
    j3.sc_90as3_flash,
    j3.sc_90as3_ly,
    j3.zrwstrtdate,
    j3.zrwenddate,
    j3.fs_comp_wk,
    j3.rx_comp_wk,
    p.ltext AS profit_center_descr,
    j3.rx_division_code,
    j3.rx_area_code,
    j3.rx_region_code,
    j3.rx_district_code
  FROM Topside_With_Retail_Calendar j3
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT p
    ON j3.prctr = p.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (FS Variant)
-- Logic: Aggregates all base measures with SUM, grouped by every
--        non-measure output attribute. Computes:
--          cal_comp_flag = GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk)  [scalar max]
--          cal_week_number = RIGHT(week_year, 2)              [rightmost 2 chars]
--          cal_sc_90as3_flash/bud/fct/ly = calculated measures
--            applied after aggregation per CUBE/Aggregation semantics.
-- Source: Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text
-- Aggregation: SUM on 16 base measures; GROUP BY on all 34 non-measure attributes
-- Calculation: GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) AS cal_comp_flag
--              RIGHT(week_year, 2) AS cal_week_number
--              CASE-based calculated measures (CAL_SC_90AS3_*)
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  application,
  description,
  prctr,
  s4_account,
  segment,
  type,
  week_year,
  zyear,
  strnum,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  city,
  state,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) AS cal_comp_flag,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  profit_center_descr,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  RIGHT(week_year, 2) AS cal_week_number,

  SUM(fs_bud)        AS fs_bud,
  SUM(fs_fct)        AS fs_fct,
  SUM(fs_flash)      AS fs_flash,
  SUM(fs_ly)         AS fs_ly,
  SUM(rx_bud)        AS rx_bud,
  SUM(rx_fct)        AS rx_fct,
  SUM(rx_flash)      AS rx_flash,
  SUM(rx_ly)         AS rx_ly,
  SUM(sc_90as1_bud)  AS sc_90as1_bud,
  SUM(sc_90as1_fct)  AS sc_90as1_fct,
  SUM(sc_90as1_flash) AS sc_90as1_flash,
  SUM(sc_90as1_ly)   AS sc_90as1_ly,
  SUM(sc_90as3_bud)  AS sc_90as3_bud,
  SUM(sc_90as3_fct)  AS sc_90as3_fct,
  SUM(sc_90as3_flash) AS sc_90as3_flash,
  SUM(sc_90as3_ly)   AS sc_90as3_ly,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_flash) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_flash) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_flash)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_flash,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_bud) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_bud) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_bud)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_bud,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_fct) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_fct) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_fct)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_fct,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_ly) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_ly) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_ly)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_ly

FROM Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  application,
  description,
  prctr,
  s4_account,
  segment,
  type,
  week_year,
  zyear,
  strnum,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  city,
  state,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk),
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  profit_center_descr,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  RIGHT(week_year, 2);


-- =============================================================================
-- QUERY 2: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS -- RX (Pharmacy) Variant
-- NOTE: The RX variant is structurally and logically identical to the FS variant.
--       Both consume the same source views with the same join keys, filters,
--       aggregations, and calculated measures. The FS/RX distinction in the
--       lineage refers to the variant alignment of the upstream base views
--       (CV_BASE_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_CAR_RX and CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4_RX),
--       not to any difference in the composite view SQL logic itself.
--       The same runtime parameters apply.
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS
-- Logic: Reads topside adjustment facts from the physical source table
--        TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR (RX variant), filters to client
--        '110' or '200', and applies the week_year range filter.
-- Source: REQUIRES_VALIDATION.TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR
--         (BQ_FULL_TABLE not found in Columns_Mapping_v3 -- see ISSUES TO FIX)
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200')
--          week_year BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS AS (
  SELECT
    application,
    description,
    mandt,
    prctr,
    s4_account,
    segment,
    type,
    week_year,
    zyear,
    fs_bud,
    fs_fct,
    fs_flash,
    fs_ly,
    rx_bud,
    rx_fct,
    rx_flash,
    rx_ly,
    sc_90as1_bud,
    sc_90as1_fct,
    sc_90as1_flash,
    sc_90as1_ly,
    sc_90as3_bud,
    sc_90as3_fct,
    sc_90as3_flash,
    sc_90as3_ly
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: BQ_FULL_TABLE for TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR not in Columns_Mapping_v3
  FROM `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_VT_CAR`
  WHERE mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND week_year BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: STORE_ATTRIBUTES
-- Logic: Reads store master attributes from v_ztsrp_attr_act, filtered
--        to client '120' or '200'.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTRIBUTES AS (
  SELECT
    strnum,
    prctr,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Topside_With_Store_Attributes
-- Logic: Left outer joins TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS to STORE_ATTRIBUTES on prctr.
-- Source: TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (left), STORE_ATTRIBUTES (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on t.prctr = s.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Store_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    t.application,
    t.description,
    t.mandt,
    t.prctr,
    t.s4_account,
    t.segment,
    t.type,
    t.week_year,
    t.zyear,
    t.fs_bud,
    t.fs_fct,
    t.fs_flash,
    t.fs_ly,
    t.rx_bud,
    t.rx_fct,
    t.rx_flash,
    t.rx_ly,
    t.sc_90as1_bud,
    t.sc_90as1_fct,
    t.sc_90as1_flash,
    t.sc_90as1_ly,
    t.sc_90as3_bud,
    t.sc_90as3_fct,
    t.sc_90as3_flash,
    t.sc_90as3_ly,
    s.strnum,
    s.division_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.district_desc,
    s.region_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.area_code,
    s.area_desc,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code
  FROM TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS t
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTRIBUTES s
    ON t.prctr = s.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: COMP_FLAG
-- Logic: Reads comp flag data from v_ztsrp_compfl, filtered to the
--        runtime comp version parameter.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    zweek,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    comp_ver
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Topside_With_Comp_Flag
-- Logic: Left outer joins Topside_With_Store_Attributes to COMP_FLAG
--        on prctr and week_year = zweek.
-- Source: Topside_With_Store_Attributes (left), COMP_FLAG (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j1.prctr = c.prctr AND j1.week_year = c.zweek
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Comp_Flag AS (
  SELECT
    j1.mandt,
    j1.application,
    j1.description,
    j1.prctr,
    j1.s4_account,
    j1.segment,
    j1.type,
    j1.week_year,
    j1.zyear,
    j1.strnum,
    j1.division_code,
    j1.division_desc,
    j1.district_code,
    j1.district_desc,
    j1.region_desc,
    j1.region_code,
    j1.rep_mkt_code,
    j1.rep_mkt_desc,
    j1.city,
    j1.state,
    j1.fs_open_dat,
    j1.rx_open_dat,
    j1.area_code,
    j1.area_desc,
    j1.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j1.fs_bud,
    j1.fs_fct,
    j1.fs_flash,
    j1.fs_ly,
    j1.rx_bud,
    j1.rx_fct,
    j1.rx_flash,
    j1.rx_ly,
    j1.sc_90as1_bud,
    j1.sc_90as1_fct,
    j1.sc_90as1_flash,
    j1.sc_90as1_ly,
    j1.sc_90as3_bud,
    j1.sc_90as3_fct,
    j1.sc_90as3_flash,
    j1.sc_90as3_ly,
    c.fs_comp_wk,
    c.rx_comp_wk,
    j1.rx_division_code,
    j1.rx_area_code,
    j1.rx_region_code,
    j1.rx_district_code
  FROM Topside_With_Store_Attributes j1
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG c
    ON j1.prctr = c.prctr
   AND j1.week_year = c.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: RETAIL_CALENDAR
-- Logic: Reads retail calendar week data from v_ztfigl_rcalweek.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- =====================================================================
RETAIL_CALENDAR AS (
  SELECT
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    zzweek
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Topside_With_Retail_Calendar
-- Logic: Left outer joins Topside_With_Comp_Flag to RETAIL_CALENDAR
--        on week_year = zzweek, adding zrwstrtdate and zrwenddate.
-- Source: Topside_With_Comp_Flag (left), RETAIL_CALENDAR (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j2.week_year = r.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Retail_Calendar AS (
  SELECT
    j2.sc_90as3_ly,
    j2.sc_90as3_flash,
    j2.sc_90as3_fct,
    j2.sc_90as3_bud,
    j2.sc_90as1_ly,
    j2.sc_90as1_flash,
    j2.sc_90as1_fct,
    j2.sc_90as1_bud,
    j2.rx_ly,
    j2.rx_flash,
    j2.rx_fct,
    j2.rx_bud,
    j2.fs_ly,
    j2.fs_flash,
    j2.fs_fct,
    j2.fs_bud,
    j2.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j2.area_desc,
    j2.area_code,
    j2.rx_open_dat,
    j2.fs_open_dat,
    j2.state,
    j2.city,
    j2.rep_mkt_desc,
    j2.rep_mkt_code,
    j2.region_code,
    j2.region_desc,
    j2.district_desc,
    j2.district_code,
    j2.division_desc,
    j2.division_code,
    j2.strnum,
    j2.zyear,
    j2.week_year,
    j2.type,
    j2.segment,
    j2.s4_account,
    j2.prctr,
    j2.description,
    j2.application,
    j2.mandt,
    r.zrwstrtdate,
    r.zrwenddate,
    j2.fs_comp_wk,
    j2.rx_comp_wk,
    j2.rx_division_code,
    j2.rx_area_code,
    j2.rx_region_code,
    j2.rx_district_code
  FROM Topside_With_Comp_Flag j2
  LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CALENDAR r
    ON j2.week_year = r.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Reads profit center text from v_cepct.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    prctr,
    ltext
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text
-- Logic: Left outer joins Topside_With_Retail_Calendar to
--        PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on prctr, adding ltext as profit_center_descr.
-- Source: Topside_With_Retail_Calendar (left), PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (right)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j3.prctr = p.prctr
-- Calculation: ltext renamed to profit_center_descr
-- =====================================================================
Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text AS (
  SELECT
    j3.mandt,
    j3.application,
    j3.description,
    j3.prctr,
    j3.s4_account,
    j3.segment,
    j3.type,
    j3.week_year,
    j3.zyear,
    j3.strnum,
    j3.division_code,
    j3.division_desc,
    j3.district_code,
    j3.district_desc,
    j3.region_desc,
    j3.region_code,
    j3.rep_mkt_code,
    j3.rep_mkt_desc,
    j3.city,
    j3.state,
    j3.fs_open_dat,
    j3.rx_open_dat,
    j3.area_code,
    j3.area_desc,
    j3.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j3.fs_bud,
    j3.fs_fct,
    j3.fs_flash,
    j3.fs_ly,
    j3.rx_bud,
    j3.rx_fct,
    j3.rx_flash,
    j3.rx_ly,
    j3.sc_90as1_bud,
    j3.sc_90as1_fct,
    j3.sc_90as1_flash,
    j3.sc_90as1_ly,
    j3.sc_90as3_bud,
    j3.sc_90as3_fct,
    j3.sc_90as3_flash,
    j3.sc_90as3_ly,
    j3.zrwstrtdate,
    j3.zrwenddate,
    j3.fs_comp_wk,
    j3.rx_comp_wk,
    p.ltext AS profit_center_descr,
    j3.rx_division_code,
    j3.rx_area_code,
    j3.rx_region_code,
    j3.rx_district_code
  FROM Topside_With_Retail_Calendar j3
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT p
    ON j3.prctr = p.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (RX Variant)
-- Logic: Identical aggregation and calculation logic as FS variant.
--        SUM on 16 base measures, GROUP BY on all non-measure attributes,
--        GREATEST for cal_comp_flag, RIGHT for cal_week_number,
--        CASE-based calculated measures.
-- Source: Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  application,
  description,
  prctr,
  s4_account,
  segment,
  type,
  week_year,
  zyear,
  strnum,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  city,
  state,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) AS cal_comp_flag,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  profit_center_descr,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  RIGHT(week_year, 2) AS cal_week_number,

  SUM(fs_bud)        AS fs_bud,
  SUM(fs_fct)        AS fs_fct,
  SUM(fs_flash)      AS fs_flash,
  SUM(fs_ly)         AS fs_ly,
  SUM(rx_bud)        AS rx_bud,
  SUM(rx_fct)        AS rx_fct,
  SUM(rx_flash)      AS rx_flash,
  SUM(rx_ly)         AS rx_ly,
  SUM(sc_90as1_bud)  AS sc_90as1_bud,
  SUM(sc_90as1_fct)  AS sc_90as1_fct,
  SUM(sc_90as1_flash) AS sc_90as1_flash,
  SUM(sc_90as1_ly)   AS sc_90as1_ly,
  SUM(sc_90as3_bud)  AS sc_90as3_bud,
  SUM(sc_90as3_fct)  AS sc_90as3_fct,
  SUM(sc_90as3_flash) AS sc_90as3_flash,
  SUM(sc_90as3_ly)   AS sc_90as3_ly,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_flash) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_flash) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_flash)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_flash,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_bud) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_bud) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_bud)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_bud,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_fct) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_fct) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_fct)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_fct,

  CASE
    WHEN segment IN ('CMX', 'MC') THEN CAST(0 AS NUMERIC)
    ELSE SUM(sc_90as3_ly) +
         CASE
           WHEN s4_account = '804013' THEN SUM(sc_90as1_ly) * 2
           ELSE SUM(sc_90as1_ly)
         END
  END AS cal_sc_90as3_ly

FROM Topside_With_Profit_Center_Text
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  application,
  description,
  prctr,
  s4_account,
  segment,
  type,
  week_year,
  zyear,
  strnum,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  city,
  state,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk),
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  profit_center_descr,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  RIGHT(week_year, 2);
